scenes.text: Har coaching institute ki kahani ek jaisi hai. Attendance ka register, fees ka register, aur admissions ki diary.
Aur phir ek din... register hi gum ho gaya.
Ab kisne fees di, kisne nahi? Kaun kitne din absent tha? Kuch pata nahi. Bas tension aur sir dard.
Isi problem ka solution hai, EduBuddy.
Login karte hi poora institute ek screen pe. Kitne students, kitni fees baaki, aur naye admissions.
Attendance? Absent pe tap karo, aur ek click mein parents ko WhatsApp chala jaata hai.
Fees aayi? Record karo, receipt turant ready. Kisne diya, kisne nahi, sab saamne.
Kisi bhi student ki detail chahiye? Bas naam search karo.
Har inquiry save hoti hai, follow-up date ke saath. Koi admission haath se nahi jaayega.
Aur sab kuch cloud pe safe. Register kho sakta hai, aapka data nahi.
EduBuddy. Register chhodo, institute chalao. Aaj hi free demo book karein.
